meta.name: implement-plan
meta.description: Execute an approved plan increment-by-increment with deterministic verification at each step. Use whenever the user says "implement the plan", "run the plan", "execute the plan", "work through the increments", "do the plan", or invokes /implement-plan. Done-criteria are checked against evidence on disk, not asserted from memory; failures escalate through a layered ladder rather than repeated identical attempts; existing code gets behavior-preservation tests before modification; file divergence (touched vs declared) is reconciled before each commit; structured outcome records land in the plan file. Designed for fresh sessions with no prior context. Do NOT use for planning itself — use `plan-small` or `plan-large`. Do NOT use for unplanned coding without a plan file — use `coding-process`. Do NOT use when the user wants audits in the loop — use `implement-plan-audited`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
